description.value: Open since 1996, New Saigon is one of the Fraser Valley's longest-running Vietnamese restaurants, known for house specialties like the Henry Special, homemade Coconut Curry Chicken Stew, and a full Pho menu. The casual strip-mall location offers dine-in with table service as well as online pickup and delivery ordering. It has been consistently recognized as a top dining destination in the Fraser Valley.
